{{Quote|The Republic Office of Criminal Investigations has tasked the Sector Rangers with rooting out ration fraud and enforcing the Victory Rationing Orders and Regulation Plan.|HoloNet News report|<ref name="holo" />}}
The '''Republic Office of Criminal Investigations''' ('''ROCI''') was the primary [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|criminal investigative service]] managed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]]. The ROCI was charged with coordinating criminal investigations,<ref name="holo" /> operating the [[Sector Ranger/Legends|Sector Rangers]],<ref name="Gamer" /> and managing the [[Republic Enforcement DataCore/Legends|Republic Enforcement DataCore]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|95|Republic Office of Criminal Investigations}}</ref> It was headquartered at the [[Judicial Arcology/Legends|Judicial Arcology]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="holo" />

At the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> an issue of the [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|CoCo District Edition]] of the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] stated the Republic [[General Ministry]] initiated the [[Victory Rationing Orders and Regulation Plan]] to manage war materials and slow spiraling inflation.<ref name="holo" /> By [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="DateHolo">{{InsiderCite|67|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 14:4:14}} and {{InsiderCite|73|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 15:01:15 Edition}} are set in 14:4:14 and 15:01:15 respectively, which corresponds to [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> the program was dealing with problems of fraud, and in response, the ROCI tasked the Sector Rangers with the enforcement of the plan's regulations.<ref name="holo" /> In 21 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="DateHolo" /> a [[Shadowfeed/Legends|CIS Shadowfeed]] issue stated that<ref name="Insider 73">{{InsiderCite|73|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 15:01:15 Edition}}</ref> the [[Moon/Legends|moon]]<ref name="TEGTPAM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] was outside the ROCI's jurisdiction.<ref name="Insider 73" /> With the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the ROCI was reorganized as the [[Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations/Legends|Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations]].<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Republic Office of Criminal Investigations was first mentioned in ''[[Special Ops: The Sector Ranger]]'', an article by [[James Maliszewski]] published in the magazine ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]''<ref name="Gamer" /> on [[December 21]], [[2001]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20011210.html|text=Yuuzhan Vong Invade ''Gamer'' #8}}</ref>
